Q: VSCode jumpiness when editing markdown and preview pane is open A:

I was able to circumvent this problem by activating

markdown.preview.doubleClickToSwitchToEditor

When switching from the preview to the editor, double click any word on the preview side.

Q: Find multiple radius in one contour using OpenCV Python A:

Here is a solution using a least squares circle fit in Python OpenCV.

  • Read the input

  • Convert to grayscale

  • Threshold

  • Get the coordinates of all the white points in the threshold image

  • Compute the least squares circle solution for the center and radius of the points using Scipy code

  • Print the values for center, radius and resudual

  • Draw the circle as red on a copy of the input

  • Save the images

Input image:

import cv2
import numpy as np
from scipy import optimize

# Reference: https://scipy-cookbook.readthedocs.io/items/Least_Squares_Circle.html

# Finding the least squares circle corresponds to finding the center of the 
# circle (xc, yc) and its radius Rc which minimize the residual function defined below, 
# which linearizes the problem (FW):
# Ri = sqrt( (x - xc)**2 + (y - yc)**2), where Ri is distance from center for point (x,y)
# residual = sum( (Ri - Rc)**2)

def calc_R(c):
    # calculate the distance of each 2D point from the center (xc, yc)
    return np.sqrt((x-c[0])**2 + (y-c[1])**2)

def calc_leastsq(c):
    # calculate the difference between the radius (distance) of the points from the 
    # center and the mean of all the computed radii, i.e, residuals for each point
    Ri = calc_R(c)
    return Ri - Ri.mean()

# Read image
img = cv2.imread('arc.png')
hh, ww = img.shape[:2]

# Convert to grayscale
gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

# threshold
thresh = cv2.threshold(gray, 0, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY+cv2.THRESH_OTSU)[1]

# get the coordinates of the white points
points = np.column_stack(np.where(thresh.transpose() > 0))
x = points[:, 0]
y = points[:, 1]

# get estimated center from mean of both x and y values
# if points form full circle, the mean will be close to the true center
# if points for arc, the mean will not be close to the true center
x_m = np.mean(x)
y_m = np.mean(y)
center_estimate = x_m, y_m

# compute least square center
# format: optimize.leastsq(residual function, estimate of argument to be determined)
center = optimize.leastsq(calc_leastsq, center_estimate)[0]
xc, yc = center

# compute radius and residual using calc_R def above
Ri = calc_R(center)
R = Ri.mean()
residual = np.sum((Ri - R)**2)
print('')
print(f"center: ({xc:.4f}, {yc:.4f})  radius: {R:.4f}  residual: {residual:.4f}")
print('')

# draw circle
result = img.copy()
xc = int(xc)
yc = int(yc)
R = int(R)
cv2.circle(result, (xc, yc), R, (0, 0, 255), 1)

# save results
cv2.imwrite('arc_thresh.png', thresh)
cv2.imwrite('arc_circle.png', result)

# show images
cv2.imshow('thresh', thresh)
cv2.imshow('result', result)
cv2.waitKey(0)
cv2.destroyAllWindows()

Q: Sending Email with attachment by MS-Outlook in VBA, Excel when Outlook is closed A:

Sorry, I misinterpreted your question just now. With reference to here, you need to add the following code. 

Dim OutApp As Outlook.Application 
Dim OutMail As Outlook.MailItem

On Error Resume Next 
Set OutApp = GetObject(, "Outlook.Application") 
If OutApp Is Nothing Then 
    Set OutApp = CreateObject("Outlook.Application") 
End If 
On Error Goto 0 

Set OutMail = OutApp.CreateItem(olMailItem) 
With OutMail 
    .To = "address@domain.com" ' continue from here

Q: Excel table default value and data validation without VBA A:

One way to solve this would be to use a helper column. You can use the data validation list for the entry column, say column A. You can use a formula in the hidden column B with the formula =IF(A1,"Invoiced","Invoiced","Not invoiced")

Q: apache syslog-ng error logs and access logs A:

I had the same problem, and i found that the the ErrorLog and CustomLog settings were getting overwritten by /etc/apache2/sites-available/default

After commenting out those, it worked !

Or you can just put these settings in < virtualhost > if you want to log only specific domain calls

Regards rane
